title: Registry subdomain entry
description: One entry per file. The filename must be <subdomain>.<domain>.json (e.g. mc.is-a.ceo.json, @.is-a.ceo.json, *.app.is-a.ceo.json). Zones come from the entries themselves: every zone that appears in the data is declared in dnsconfig.js.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this file, usually ./SCHEMA.json.

domain.description: The zone this subdomain belongs to, e.g. is-a.ceo. The zone must already exist in the Cloudflare account the API token can edit.

subdomain.description: The zone apex (@), a wildcard (*.app, only over a base name you already claim; a bare zone-wide * is maintainer-only), or dot-separated DNS labels. Labels are lowercase; each may start with an underscore (e.g. _acme-challenge) and is at most 63 characters.

owner.description: Your GitHub username, so people can reach you. Must match the PR author.

email.description: Optional contact address, e.g. you@example.com. The fastest way for maintainers to reach you; format-checked by CI when present.

proxied.description: Route A/AAAA/CNAME through the Cloudflare proxy. Defaults to false because proxying breaks GitHub Pages certificate issuance.

repo.description: owner/repo or github.com/owner/repo, or a full https:// URL. Shown on the site.

description.description: One line, shown on the site.

records.description: Omit entirely to get the GitHub Pages default.
